title: Alibi and Inheritance
author: Wren Crane
blurb: Casper Nakamura, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
